'''Jillari''' is a ''[[damane]]'' from [[Seanchan]].

== Appearance ==
She is slight and has long, fiery red hair with green eyes. She appears to be in her middle years.

== Activities ==
She is captured by [[Rand al'Thor]]'s forces on the Seanchan campaign for [[Illian]]. She is sent to [[Elayne Trakand]] in [[Caemlyn]].

[[Reanne Corly]] begins to take her on walks around the Caemlyn palace, to show her how to act like a free woman again, and tries to get her to choose a surname.

Progress on her assimilation into a free channeler is unknown after Reanne's murder.
